mcqs.question: Which company partnered for a carrier-neutral Cable Landing Station in Visakhapatnam to support Visakhapatnam–Singapore connectivity?
mcqs.explanation: Orange Group of France partnered for the carrier-neutral Cable Landing Station in Visakhapatnam, supporting connectivity with Singapore. Google and Reliance received approvals for data centres, while Sify was developing a 500 MW data centre; none of them was the partner for this Cable Landing Station.
